## tiny-frame-mm.ifc

Hand-written for this package (no third-party content). IFC4, millimetre
units, one storey at 3000 mm, an HEA 200 column, a 200x400 rectangular beam,
an IfcPlate ("Shear tab", no geometry), property sets with marks, a typed
column with a type-level pset, one IfcRelConnectsElements.
